answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 7874 Country: United Kingdom Title: How old was Hazrat Salman Farsi R.A when he passed away? 2-Where and how did he pass away? 3-Where was he buried? please provide refrence. Question: Assalaamualaikum 1-How old was Hazrat Salman Farsi R.A when he passed away? 2-Where and how did he pass away? 3-Where was he buried? please provide refrence. Answer ID: 7874 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1653/1521=D/1429) (1) Hadhrat Salman Farsi ( رضی اللہ عنہ ) is said to have reached to an age of 250 years while according to some scholars he was 350 year old. The former opinion is more likely to be correct. (2) He died in Madaain and was buried there. (Al-Ikmal fi Asma Al-Rijal) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
